pipelines.name: Markdownlint
findings: [LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'lint' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).

findings: [MEDIUM] NO_CACHE: MEDIUM: Workflow installs dependencies without 'actions/cache' or setup action caching.
[CRITICAL] HARDCODED_SECRET: Potential hardcoded credential in job 'test' step env 'PASSWORD'. Use GitHub Secrets instead.
[HIGH] EXCESSIVE_PERMISSIONS: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.

anti_patterns.message: MEDIUM: Workflow installs dependencies without 'actions/cache' or setup action caching.
anti_patterns.remediation: Enable built-in caching on setup-* actions (e.g., cache: 'pip' or 'npm') or add an explicit actions/cache step.

anti_patterns.message: Potential hardcoded credential in job 'test' step env 'PASSWORD'. Use GitHub Secrets instead.
anti_patterns.remediation: Remove literal secret values and reference encrypted GitHub Secrets via ${{ secrets.SECRET_NAME }} or OIDC federation.

anti_patterns.message: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
anti_patterns.remediation: Declare explicit least-privilege 'permissions:' (for example, contents: read) at the workflow or job level.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'test' runs actions/checkout without 'persist-credentials: false' and uploads build artifacts.
anti_patterns.remediation: Set 'with: persist-credentials: false' on actions/checkout steps in jobs that upload artifacts.
